instruction: I'm preparing references for my NLP thesis. The docx file lists several papers. Please export DBLP bibtex for the Attention paper (Attention is All you Need) to 'references.bib'. Make sure to get the published conference version, not arxiv.

metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting DBLP bibtex for 'Attention is All you Need' conference version (not arxiv). Evaluator verifies: (1) title contains 'Attention', (2) entry type is @inproceedings (conference), (3) booktitle contains NIPS/NeurIPS, (4) has >=5 authors, (5) Vaswani is in author list. All checks must pass.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary: 1.0 if all checks pass (correct title, conference version, NIPS/NeurIPS, >=5 authors, has Vaswani), 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies all instruction requirements - correct paper (title + Vaswani author), conference version (entry type @inproceedings + NIPS/NeurIPS booktitle), and completeness (>=5 authors)
Correct semantic logic: Getter properly parses bibtex file, identifies Attention paper by title, extracts all needed fields (entry_type, title, authors, booktitle)
Correct comparison logic: Metric verifies 6 conditions - has_entry, has_attention_title, is_conference, is_nips, author_count>=5, has_vaswani
Proper conference vs arxiv distinction: Checks entry_type='inproceedings' (not 'article') AND booktitle contains NIPS/NeurIPS
Robust paper identification: Uses multiple verification points (title contains 'Attention', Vaswani in authors, NIPS/NeurIPS conference, >=5 authors) to avoid false positives
Edge cases handled: Getter handles empty file, no matching entry, multiple entries (correctly identifies target by title), incomplete bibtex entries
